attributes.basis: Capacity basis: legacy_ratio, mapped_capacity, nominal_full_pack or configured; a nominal pack estimate is not independently verified usable capacity.
attributes.fallback_reason: Resolver reason: ok for a valid selected source, or the provider failure that caused configured fallback or unavailability.
attributes.observed_at: Accepted source observation as an aware ISO timestamp, or null for legacy/configured values or unavailable evidence; never the render time.
attributes.source: Actual capacity provenance: legacy_ratio, mapped_entity, tessie, configured or configured_fallback; null before an observation exists.

fields.availability: Legacy mode retains the existing learned-limit capacity projection. Other modes expose accepted capacity independently of charge-limit learning; missing/invalid selected evidence requires an explicitly configured fallback or remains unavailable.
fields.definition: Capacity used for EV energy and timing planning from the selected legacy ratio, mapped capacity, loaded Tessie nominal full-pack estimate or configured value. A nominal/configured value is not independent proof of physically usable battery capacity.

equivalents.tessie: Optional read-only nominal full-pack estimate from the already-loaded coordinator for the explicitly mapped car

fields.producer: ActiveEvController.capacity_observation via EvReadModel; legacy state retains LearnedChargeLimitDecision.usable_capacity_kwh
fields.time_basis: Accepted provider observation timestamp where available; legacy and configured values have no invented source timestamp
fields.unit_and_sign: kWh; positive planning capacity, not power, SoC, or a verified battery-health measurement

entity_revisions.previous_definition: Estimated full usable EV battery capacity derived from mapped stored energy and vehicle SoC.
